query: 书里说 PEB 期间光刻胶的酸损失有哪几种机制？然后据此解释一下 TiN 衬底上光刻胶图形底部出现 footing 的原因，并给出衬底酸捕获的速率表达式和陷阱浓度的定义式。
gold_standard: 链式回答:(1) PEB 期间酸损失机制有三种——聚合物内部陷阱捕获(陷阱远多于酸时为一级动力学 ∂h/∂t′ = −K_loss·h)、从胶顶面蒸发(∂h/∂t′|_{z=0} = −K_evap[h(0,t) − h_air(0,t)])、衬底碱污染;(2) TiN 与 S_xN_y 衬底中的氮充当酸分子的捕获位点，消耗本应参与放大反应的酸，降低显影速率，从而在图形底部形成 footing;(3) 衬底捕获速率为 ∂h/∂t′|_{z=D} = −K_trap·h(D,t)·s(式 2.156),陷阱浓度定义为 s = S/G0(相对初始 PAG 浓度，式 2.155)。
success_criteria: 列出三种酸损失机制，正确解释 TiN 氮捕获位点→酸减少→显影速率降低→footing 的因果，并写出式 2.156 与 s = S/G0 两个表达式。
evidence: --[p107]-- base contamination from the substrate, as has been reported on TiN and $\mathbf { S } _ { x } \mathbf { N } _ { y }$ substrates and exemplified by a foot at the bottom of the profile. The nitrogen in these substrates acts as trapping sites for acid molecules, effectively resulting in the reduction of the desired amplification reactions, the development rate, and, consequently, the resist footing. --[p108]-- $$s = \frac { S } { G _ { 0 } } .\tag{2.155}$$ The assumption is made that one trap site reacts with one acid molecule, such that the rate of acid trapping in the substrates is therefore expressed as $$\left. \frac { \partial h } { \partial t ^ { \prime } } \right| _ { z = D } = - K _ { \mathrm { t r a p } } h ( D , t ) s .\tag{2.156}$$
